method: Complete unchanged Functions/Squares programs, checked canonical stdout and empty stderr. Fresh process, hard timeout via production pidfd helper. Equal-length exec/AOT aliases. Five cells shuffled each round; paired ratios within the same workload/round. Normal CPU pool primary; parent/child CPU2 diagnostic. All source checks and hashes precede scoped inode cache normalization and two warmups; no compilation in timed region.
causal_limit: Compared with the frozen original full host, subset_full includes the selected stdio implementation and an explicit restricted engine profile. subset_min uses the same shared host source compiled for the official minimal SDK with AOT-only guards. Profile, source, SDK and artifact identities differ as recorded; the package gain does not isolate compiler removal or binary-size causality. Newly compiled native and guest bytes match the frozen prior artifacts; native execution is fresh in every round.
